name: Movement Studies
notes: The movement studies minor consists of a minimum of 26 credits: at least 10 in foundations, at least 4 in embodied practices/dance appreciation, and the remainder from movement studies/somatic awareness.

Requirements are stated in CREDITS and many DANC courses are 1-2 credits rather than 4. Each group below converts its credit minimum into a course count using the modal credit value of that group's own option list; confirm your credit totals with the program.
The third group is the page's explicit top-up category ('use the following courses to complete the remaining 26 credits'), so its course count is the roughest conversion in this entry.

NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: Experience in Technical Production - a combination of red (13+ hours), yellow (6-12 hours) and green (0-5 hours) jobs on program productions. For movement studies: one green job, one yellow job, and either one red job or an additional green and yellow job.
NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: students enrolled in any dance course must attend at least two program-sponsored performances and two program-sponsored workshops each semester.

requirementGroups.label: Foundations (10 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Foundations. Choose at least 10 credits from the following: DANC 102: Fundamentals of Movement (2 credits); DANC 170: Embodied Resourcing Through Somatic Practices (4 credits); DANC 195: World Dance: Movement as Culture (4 credits); DANC 200: Anatomy and Kinesiology (4 credits); DANC 204: Contact Improvisation and Culture (4 credits); DANC 211: Tai Chi: Explorations (4 credits); DANC 230: Living Anatomy, Living Yoga (4 credits); DANC 288: Movement Analysis and Integration (4 credits)
requirementGroups.note: Almost all of these are 4 credits, so three of them clear the 10-credit floor.

requirementGroups.label: Embodied practices / dance appreciation (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Embodied Practices/Dance Appreciation. Choose at least four credits from the following: DANC 104; DANC 109; DANC 110; DANC 116; DANC 126; DANC 140; DANC 145; DANC 150; DANC 155; DANC 160; DANC 171; DANC 181; DANC 182; DANC 185; DANC 187; DANC 188; DANC 189; DANC 190; DANC 197; DANC 212; DANC 253; DANC 266; DANC 267; DANC 268; DANC 269; DANC 273; DANC 278; DANC 279; DANC 281; DANC 283; DANC 285; DANC 290; DANC 296; DANC 365; DANC 377; DANC 378; DANC 379; DANC 380; DANC 397; DANC 398
requirementGroups.note: Most of this list is 2 credits, so two courses reach the 4-credit floor.

requirementGroups.label: Movement studies / somatic awareness (remaining credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Movement Studies/Somatic Awareness. Use the following courses to complete the remaining 26 credits: DANC 106; DANC 114; DANC 115; DANC 130; DANC 167M; DANC 202; DANC 208; DANC 209; DANC 218; DANC 225; DANC 233; DANC 235; DANC 258; DANC 271; DANC 305
requirementGroups.note: This category is explicitly the top-up to 26 credits: about 12 credits remain after foundations and embodied practice, which four courses from this mixed 2-and-4-credit list roughly supply.
